description: Defines the NetworkAnonymizationKey class used for network state partitioning based on site and cross-site properties, including methods for creation, comparison, serialization, and testing.

classes.name: net::NetworkAnonymizationKey
classes.description: A class representing a key used to partition shared network state based on site and cross-site properties, with support for creation, comparison, serialization, and testing.

methods.name: CreateSameSite
methods.description: Creates a NetworkAnonymizationKey assuming the site is same-site with no nonce.

methods.name: CreateCrossSite
methods.description: Creates a NetworkAnonymizationKey assuming the site is cross-site with no nonce.

methods.name: CreateFromFrameSite
methods.description: Creates a NetworkAnonymizationKey from top frame site and frame site, calculating cross-site status.

methods.name: CreateFromNetworkIsolationKey
methods.description: Creates a NetworkAnonymizationKey from a NetworkIsolationKey.

methods.name: CreateFromParts
methods.description: Creates a NetworkAnonymizationKey from its constituent parts: site, cross-site flag, and optional nonce.

methods.name: ToDoUseTopFrameOriginAsWell
methods.description: Temporary method to create a key from a frame origin, used when only frame origin is available.

methods.name: CreateTransient
methods.description: Creates a transient, opaque NetworkAnonymizationKey.

methods.name: ToDebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the key for debugging.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if all parts of the key are empty.

methods.name: IsFullyPopulated
methods.description: Checks if the top frame site is populated.

methods.name: IsTransient
methods.description: Checks if the key is short-lived and not suitable for persistent storage.

methods.name: GetTopFrameSite
methods.description: Returns the top frame site.

methods.name: IsCrossSite
methods.description: Returns whether the key is cross-site.

methods.name: IsSameSite
methods.description: Returns whether the key is same-site.

methods.name: GetNonce
methods.description: Returns the nonce associated with the key.

methods.name: ToValue
methods.description: Serializes the key to a base::Value for storage or transmission.

methods.name: FromValue
methods.description: Deserializes a base::Value into a NetworkAnonymizationKey.

methods.name: IsPartitioningEnabled
methods.description: Checks if network state partitioning is enabled based on feature flags.

methods.name: PartitionByDefault
methods.description: Enables default partitioning regardless of feature flags.

methods.name: ClearGlobalsForTesting
methods.description: Clears any global state related to partitioning for testing purposes.
